cli.label: Claude Code
cli.interface_and_execution_location: Terminal CLI running against a local Linux workspace, with inference provided by Anthropic.
modes: Interactive CLI where a capability requires it, with mode differences recorded
platforms: Ubuntu 24.04 (Linux scope; sandbox dependency requirements apply)
cli.account_and_tier: Proposed: Claude Pro with Anthropic sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
cli.model_support: Anthropic-hosted models available to the selected account. Individual model choice, limits and availability remain account-dependent.
included_components: Native repository instructions, shell and file tools, permission rules, print-mode controls and optional Bash sandbox
exclusions: Desktop, web and editor extensions; separately integrated Agent SDK; Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry routes
Third-party MCP servers, plugins, browser integration and added skills
cli.instructions_and_permissions: Document CLAUDE.md scope and loading, permission precedence and differences between tool rules and the Bash sandbox.

app.label: Claude Code in Claude Desktop Code tab (Windows local)
app.interface_and_execution_location: Native Windows desktop coding interface using local project files and tools; model inference is hosted by the vendor.
modes: Interactive local desktop coding sessions; planning, approvals and other documented modes considered separately
platforms: Windows 11, native local execution; WSL and remote/cloud sessions excluded
app.account_and_tier: Proposed: Claude Pro with Anthropic sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
app.model_support: Anthropic-hosted models available to the selected account. Individual model choice, limits and availability remain account-dependent.
included_components: Native project context, editing, command execution, review and permission controls
Native instruction, skill and MCP mechanisms only; no added connections
exclusions: CLI and IDE extensions as separate product surfaces
Cloud, SSH and WSL execution; consumer chat and non-coding modes
Added MCP servers, plugins, custom skills, external providers and enterprise administration
app.instructions_and_permissions: Assess app-specific modes, native local execution policy and documented shared configuration; never infer an OS sandbox from a Git worktree.
